name: control-iq
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with Control-IQ on throughout, and still on when the app connects: the algorithm's rate moves between 0 and 1.4 U/hr, it gives automatic boluses of 0.6 U 260 minutes ago and 0.4 U 80 minutes ago, and a 4.0 U bolus from the pump's screen 120 minutes ago. Every BasalDelivery record is Control-IQ's. TandemKit's setup asks to turn Control-IQ off, so this is meant for the walk setup. The pump shows about 3.1 U IOB.
